metadata.name: Card-reader setup
metadata.description: One setup of a branch library's onboarding: which card reader the branch has, where it stands, and whether it read a test card. Three myapp.step blocks over priv/fixtures/card_reader_setup_screens.json, so the person setting it up may go back to the step before, under a myapp.setup root that declares one ending besides done. Runnable alone, and written to run as a child of the onboarding: it finishes with the outcome done, or with site_visit_needed when the test card was not read.

datamodel.description: What the steps collected, keyed by question key. Each myapp.step writes responses.<key> for the keys it names, from the press that finished it.
